VI.description: Moves and/or resizes the window hWnd and sets its Z order through user32.dll SetWindowPos (stdcall\2C called in any thread). X and Y are SCREEN pixels for a top-level window. uFlags 0x15 = SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE moves the window only\2C without resizing\2C reordering or activating it - that is how RemoteVI Post Input.vi moves an open LabVIEW popup under the host cursor. return value is the Win32 BOOL\3A non-zero on success. When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.

Control.description: Z-order position (HWND or HWND_TOP 0\2C HWND_BOTTOM 1\2C HWND_TOPMOST -1\2C HWND_NOTOPMOST -2). Ignored with SWP_NOZORDER.
New left edge in screen pixels. Ignored with SWP_NOMOVE.
New top edge in screen pixels. Ignored with SWP_NOMOVE.
New width in pixels. Ignored with SWP_NOSIZE.
New height in pixels. Ignored with SWP_NOSIZE.
SWP_* flags. Default 0x15 = SWP_NOSIZE 0x1 | SWP_NOZORDER 0x4 | SWP_NOACTIVATE 0x10\3A move only. SWP_NOMOVE 0x2\2C SWP_SHOWWINDOW 0x40\2C SWP_HIDEWINDOW 0x80.
When this carries an error the DLL is not called and the error is passed to error out.

Indicator.description: error in\2C or the Call Library Function Node's own error.
